task: Check function ownership summaries when an owned parameter is placed into an object constructor.
observation: For wrap(value) returning Box(payload=value), C++ rejected later use of value while Java accepted it because function summaries did not account for constructor argument transfers.
impact: Java function consume inference now recognizes object constructor arguments, including named fields, and marks the matching owned parameter CONSUME. The focused C++/Java diagnostic pair agrees.

resolution.summary: Constructor argument transfers propagate into function parameter CONSUME summaries and match C++ on caller reuse; all eleven Java test classes pass under ABI-v9 and staged ABI-v10. Generic constructors and branch-sensitive aliases remain open.
